note: Period-lexicon rules for the yewujiang line (唐宋语汇古装). forbidden_terms are modern / sci-fi words that must not appear in spoken dialogue, subtitles or on-screen text; canonical_names maps the one accepted spelling of each character name to the variant spellings that ASR/subtitle/writer output has produced and that must be rejected; address_terms records who addresses whom by which term so the writer and subtitle pass stay consistent. Consumed by tools/script_structure_contract_gate.py::check_lexicon (S1, contract dialogue) and by the release lexicon_violation detector (ASR + .ass + OCR). Add terms by appending; never remove a term without a supervisor order.
